messenger_reliability.why: Up from 20, and the reason it does not rise further is three defects I can see rather than a missing capability. WHAT CLOSED: 04_moments.png is populated — a photograph grid with dates, voice-note durations and the WHAT WE SENT / WHAT HAPPENED / WHAT WE FELT filters in frame. The blank gallery that held the rubric row 01 disqualifier shut for three cycles is gone, and with it the 'strictly below the floor' clause. 13_messenger_states.png shows all five delivery states including the refusal in red with 'it would not go' and a '(retry) try again' beneath it, so a failed message now has a way out of it. reliability.json exercises send, ack, read, reply, react, edit, delete, voice_note, video, viewer and search, all ok. 11_chat_scroll.mp4 has 1 repeated frame in 330 — no scroll jank against the year. WHAT HOLDS IT AT THE FLOOR, and the brief is explicit that any one of these scores the row at or below 26: (1) A BLANK NOTE IN THE THREAD, on the hero messenger artifact. 13_messenger_states.png carries an empty card at y1075..1330 with zero text runs in the band and — measured against its own sidecar — zero assets/paper and zero assets/tears surfaces behind it, where all seven real notes have both. (2) ELEVEN SECONDS TO OPEN. cold_ms is 10884-12327 on all thirteen seeded scenes and 1259-1321 on the three fresh-install ones, same code, same flags, the only difference being --dart-define=SEED=year. A messenger that takes eleven seconds to show a conversation is a reason to open Instagram. (3) SEARCH IS UNUSABLE AS LAID OUT. 12_search.png spends about 65% of its height on thirteen filter chips stacked as full-width torn strips, leaving two results visible, the second clipped. Plus 02_chat shows 7 notes against the brief's floor of 8.

material_truth.why: The largest genuine gain in the set, and still capped below its floor of 22 by one clause the brief writes without qualification. WHAT CLOSED, all verified here rather than taken on trust: 06_unfolding.mp4 has 255 frames, repeated_frames 0, repeated_fraction 0.0, longest_still_run 0 — 60 unique fold frames per second against the brief's floor of 30, and the fold placeholder is gone. tools/check/paper_tooth passes 250 of 432 windows against 117 before the library was re-rendered. texture_budget peaks at 28.0 MB against the 32 MB ceiling. No screen is a flat fill any more: dominant_share runs 0.0066-0.0229 against a 0.08 ceiling on all eleven stills, including the two fresh-install screens that were flat before firing 28. At 300% on the chat hero the stock has real mottled fibre, the ruled lines are soft and uneven, and the tear edges carry fibre wisps. WHAT CAPS IT: 'Any procedural noise overlay, tiled repeating texture, or beige rounded rectangle standing in for paper scores this category below its floor.' The blank card on 13_messenger_states.png is a beige rectangle with square corners and a drop shadow standing exactly where a note should be, and its own surfaces sidecar proves no paper asset is behind it. That is the clause, met literally. Also open: the tear edges are STEPPED at 300% — the alpha masks quantise into 6-8px axis-aligned stairs on both crops, which reads as a digital cut rather than a fibre boundary; and four paper families have no tooth at all (receipt 2/16 windows, sticky_blue 8/32, sticky_pink 8/32, sticky_yellow 8/32, median_std 3.6-4.9 against a floor of 8.0). 14_media_viewer.png letterboxes its photograph against a flat #2D2C2A slab measuring std 2.609 over 21 levels.

emotional_transmission.why: Up from 10. The vocabulary is genuinely there and genuinely distinct: 34 feelings across 6 named families, and haptics.py puts the closest of 561 pairs at 2.584 JND against a floor of 2.0 with nothing under it and no shared object — so the 'a feeling sharing its haptic sequence with another' failure condition is clear, measured. A feeling arrives as an object: 13_messenger_states.png shows 'empty chair' as a line drawing ON the sheet rather than as a word in a different colour, which is the distinction the row exists for. User-authored feelings are real and first-class — the seed authors 'pigeon' and 'soup' through feeling_authored events and 05_settings.png shows both sitting under FEELINGS YOU MADE beside the built-ins. WHAT HOLDS IT DOWN: the two clips that carry this row both stutter. 07_feeling_landing.mp4 has 39 repeated frames, 10.2%, with a 10-frame hold; 15_authored_feeling.mp4 has 39, 12.7%, with a 17-frame hold — 283 ms of an arriving feeling not moving. A sensation that freezes is not a sensation. 08_state_propagating.mp4 opens with 23 identical frames before anything happens. And 01_pulse.png carries eleven partner-state readings (mood, status line, here, place, needs, has left, battery, last up, their clock, ringer, moving, signal, at home) where the brief asks for twelve as a floor — close, and I am not going to call it met from a screenshot.

coherence.why: Up from 10, on structure I can actually check. One spine: app/lib/spine/ is the only place a store is touched, every region folds the same ordered event list, and renderers.dart is now the single per-type renderer table with a test asserting the registry and the renderer set match — the drift that let a type render correctly in the thread and as a bare id in search is closed by construction. The read_marker case in the thread projection returns before _add, so read markers are not rows, which is a named failure condition and is met. Partner state rides the same torn header strip on 01, 02, 03, 04, 05 and 13. DIFF.json is a real comparison for the first time in the build's history — 8 unchanged, 7 changed, 0 new, 0 gone, 2 absent — because firing 30 seeded .previous from committed artifacts, so the numbers are finally comparable. WHAT IS OPEN: every judgement field in DIFF.json is null and the brief requires the coherence critic to assign them, so the row cannot be complete until it does. Partner state is NOT on every screen — 12_search.png and 14_media_viewer.png carry none. And six of DIFF.json's ssim values are exactly 0.9995, which is a suspiciously round repeat for six different pictures and looks like a clamp rather than a measurement; it does not change any label, but a ruler whose readings pile on one value is not one I will score above 11 on.

anti_goal.why: Three of the four forbidden interpretations are genuinely absent and I looked for them. No engagement machinery: no badge, no count, no points, no streak number anywhere in eleven stills — 05_settings.png presents rituals and history as a plain record. No emoji soup: the feelings are drawn objects and hand strokes, and there is no system glyph in the set. No product-marketing voice: the strings read 'first one's yours. whatever it is. it only goes to one person.' and 'the other phone couldn't read it.' — no exclamation mark, no app name, no third person. THE FOURTH IS NOT ABSENT, and the brief deliberately charges it here as well as to material truth so that it costs twice: the blank beige rounded card with a drop shadow on 13_messenger_states.png is simulated paper standing in for a note, backed by no paper asset in its own sidecar. 14_media_viewer.png's flat neutral slab is a second instance of a surface that is not a photograph of anything. That keeps this row below its floor of 9.

visual_design.why: Up from 8, and the gain is legibility rather than colour. LEGIBILITY IS ESSENTIALLY FIXED: 17 of 358 declared runs are below floor, 4.75%, and the tool's own qualifiers account for nearly all of it — on_moving_ground 16 and would_pass_on_ring_reading 15, so genuine sub-floor text is one or two runs. Three stills have none at all. The owner's 'the desk was giving me visibility issues with text' is answered. THE OTHER HALF OF THE OWNER'S COMPLAINT IS NOT. 'It doesn't evoke cuteness to me' is now a measurement rather than a feeling, and the measurement says the app has ONE colour. palette.json reports named_families 1 of a floor of 4, the five hue 'families' are bins at 55, 65, 75, 85 and 95 degrees — a forty-degree arc of the same paper yellow — and widest_hue_gap_deg is 320 against a ceiling of 150 on every single room and on the set, which is just the wrap-around of having no second hue. accent_fraction is 0.00058 against a floor of 0.01 and is EXACTLY 0.0 on 05_settings, 05_settings_interrupt and 17_setup_pwa: three screens with no accent colour at all. figure p99 chroma breaches on all eleven stills. mean_chroma is 0.0449 against a floor of 0.045 — it misses by one ten-thousandth. 44 breaches across the set. Add 12_search.png's layout, where thirteen filter strips eat two thirds of the screen. A build whose text is readable and whose palette has one hue and no accent is a 9.

notes_for_the_critics_and_for_ADDRESS: THE ONE THING THIS FIRING FOUND THAT NOTHING ELSE HAD: 13_messenger_states.png carries a blank card at y1075..1330. Measured, not asserted — 13_messenger_states.text.json has zero runs in that band and 13_messenger_states.surfaces.json has zero assets/paper or assets/tears rects overlapping it, while all seven real notes on the screen have one of each. The same scene log reads problems: ['pageerror: '] — an uncaught page error whose String(e) is empty. The two are almost certainly the same event.

WHY NOBODY SAW IT: tools/capture/scene.js sets exitCode 1 when problems is non-empty, AFTER writing a correct PNG, and writes the reason to stdout and to its log — never to stderr. capture.sh's run_scene books the failure with `head -1 $SCRATCH/$name.err`, which is empty on that path. So a scene that hits a runtime error is recorded as a MISSING artifact with an EMPTY reason while its picture sits on disk, complete. That is the mechanism behind the phantom 18th entry in MANIFEST.json.

SO FIRING 30'S CLASSIFICATION NEEDS SPLITTING. It filed the empty pageerror as owner_priority harness. Half of it is harness — capture.sh reading stderr where scene.js writes stdout. The other half is an uncaught runtime error and a blank message on the hero messenger screen, which is using-it, and is the single highest-value open item in the build: it is the ONE defect holding BOTH material_truth and anti_goal below their floors, and it is visible to a person holding the phone.

CANDIDATE CAUSE, narrowed but not closed, for IMPLEMENT rather than for this stage: Note._body returns a renderer's widget, and objectLanding returns SizedBox.shrink() when registry.byId(feeling_id) is null. The registry does fold feeling_authored events, and the seed authors pigeon (2025-10-16) and soup (2026-02-10), both before the frozen now — so the obvious version of this is NOT the bug and I am not filing it as one. The closing measurement either way: no painted note-sized card in any capture may lack a matching assets/paper rect in that scene's .surfaces.json, and 13_messenger_states must report problems: [].

THE COLD-START CAVEAT IS NOW SETTLED, and it settles the other way. WORKER_PROMPT 3c asked that twelve-seconds-of-cold-start be established as O(n) in the event log before being dismissed as a seeded-scene artifact again. The capture establishes it: 10884-12327 ms on the thirteen scenes served the seeded build, 1259-1321 ms on the three served the fresh build, one flag apart (--dart-define=SEED=year), 14067 events. That is 8.7x, about 0.7 ms per event, and a couple exchanging forty messages a day reaches 14067 in a year. THE HONEST LIMIT: the seeded build also ships the seed's media, so this pair cannot separate spine-open cost from bundle weight, and the exponent needs a third point at half a seed. It should not be dismissed as demo content again. It is NOT demo-content work: the owner deprioritised PRODUCING demo content, not FIXING a load-scaling defect that demo content revealed.

FOR THE VISUAL-DESIGN CRITIC SPECIFICALLY: the colour finding is structural, not a tuning nit. hue_centres_deg [55, 65, 75, 85, 95] is one hue reported as five families, so 'hue_families: 5' in palette.json should not be read as five colours.

MESSENGER_RELIABILITY IS CAPPED BY THE OWNER'S STEER AND THAT IS ACCEPTED. Part of this row is scored on evidence of a populated app, and the owner deprioritised populated demo content on 2026-09-19. The row is scored on what the artifacts show and NOT inflated to compensate, and no demo-content work is filed to lift it. A stalled heavy row beside a better app is the instruction working.

addendum_after_the_scores_still_before_a.a_general_lesson_for_the_loop: A fixed-pixel sample box is not a ruler for a defect that can move. This build has caught itself twice now on a measurement that stopped pointing at the thing it was named for — the 42-run interrupt matrix that left the screen at firing 21 and read as a legibility win, and this. Both times the number improved and the app did not. Any queue measurement written as absolute coordinates should be re-expressed against something the app declares.
